text: `for f in id tail_spans palette details; do grep -q "\`$f\`" planning/skills/executing-plans/references/progress-state-file.md || echo "$f"; done | (! grep .)` and `grep -q 'tail_spans' /mnt/vault/Portfolio/ai-tools/coder-plugins/decisions.md`, and `python3 scripts/check-usage-tokens.py && python3 scripts/check-doc-coverage.py` exit 0
why: prove-claim.py splits the Test field's first command at the backticks inside its markdown code span (`$f`), so the command cannot be passed whole (same family as BL-118). The other two commands cannot go red under a repo patch: one reads the vault's decisions.md, the other runs repo-wide validators. Run by hand on the staged tree: the loop exits 0; under a patch reverting the progress-state-file.md table it prints id, tail_spans, palette, details and exits 1; reverted, exits 0.
